# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

Participate with respect, technical honesty, and care for other people's data. Welcome questions and disagreement; critique ideas and evidence rather than people. Do not harass, threaten, demean, expose private information, or pressure anyone to share account access or sensitive reproduction material.

## Project-specific expectations

- Disclose whether a claim is verified, inferred, or based on upstream documentation.
- Do not submit private transcripts, account screenshots, credentials, or personal paths.
- Respect third-party licenses, names, and affiliation boundaries.
- Do not present unsafe automation, bypass methods, or partial results as supported behavior.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, reject, lock, or remove contributions and participation that violate these standards. Serious or repeated violations may result in a temporary or permanent ban. Reports should use a private repository channel when they include sensitive context.

Maintainers should handle reports consistently, minimize retained personal information, and explain enforcement decisions when doing so is safe.
